meta.title: Approve button opens a correct email in Outlook desktop app
gaps: Open the approval request email in the Outlook desktop app
Click the Approve action in the email
Verify the new email is addressed to the company's approval mailbox
Verify the subject is formatted as Action:Approve|Proposal:[...] with literal brackets and pipe characters
Verify the body contains (Required) Comment: followed by This is a system-generated message, content after this will be ignored
